guidance: Ironclad A0 floor7 MAP after a dangerous four-enemy elite: 14/80 HP, 189 gold, no potions, Gorget grants Plating at combat start. Only available node is Unknown row7/col3; row8 is a Rest Site and row9 Treasure. Prioritize surviving to the Rest Site. In any event, reject options that cost HP or start combat unless a strictly safer route does not exist; prefer healing or a no-HP exit. Do not pay HP for a card, relic, remove or gold while at 14 HP. If the Unknown becomes unavoidable combat, use fresh intent/hand each action; kill attackers, use Impervious on a severe attack, preserve Plating when possible, and avoid ending turn into lethal. Claim safe rewards. Stop at floor8 MAP or at a safety boundary.
